subject: SIG: batch artifact delivery & network diagram clarification
messages:
From: Elena Morales <elena.morales@blueridgehealth.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Cc: security@blueridgehealth.com
Date: Wed, 10 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SIG evidence request: network diagrams, runbooks, screenshots

Hi Priyom,

Thanks again for taking the time on the call earlier. BlueRidge is working to close our SIG review this quarter and we need a consolidated bundle of artifacts we discussed:

- Network topology and segmentation diagrams for the private deployment topology
- Runbooks for access provisioning and session handback
- Screenshots that demonstrate KMS key rotation and ephemeral session logs

Can you please share a single Drive folder with the items (or links) and call out any items that are redacted or in progress? Ideally we’d get a first pass by EOD tomorrow (Thu). If anything requires an NDA or a different delivery mechanism, let me know.

Best,
Elena Morales
Sr. Security Analyst
BlueRidge Health

[Attachment: BRH_SIG_Template.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)]

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena.morales@blueridgehealth.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Mar 2027 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG evidence request: network diagrams, runbooks, screenshots

Hi Elena — thanks for the clear list. We can assemble a single Drive bundle and flag any items that need redaction. High level plan:

1) I’ll own the artifact bundle and the Drive share.
2) Marcus will export diagrams and runbooks and mark sensitive screenshots for redaction.
3) Kim will pull the KMS rotation screenshots and provide a short explanation of what’s captured and what’s omitted.

We’ll aim to deliver a first-pass folder by tomorrow EOD PST. If BlueRidge needs a secure transfer (e.g., via SFTP) instead of Drive, tell me and we’ll arrange.

Action items for you: confirm whether screenshots with partial account IDs are acceptable, or if they must be fully redacted.

Thanks — Priyom
Priyom Das
Manager, Security & Compliance Operations
Redwood Inference

[Signature block]

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Mar 2027 08:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Drive bundle: BRH SIG artifacts (first-pass)

PRIYOM / TEAM — I uploaded the first-pass export to a Drive folder and set view-only links for BlueRidge. Items included:

- network-topology-diagram.png (diagram exported from draw.io; includes segmentation layers and abstracted CIDR ranges)
- access_runbook_v2.pdf (runbook covering ephemeral session creation and RBAC checklist)
- session-handback-playbook.txt (plain text playbook; redacted operator IDs)
- kms_rotation_notes.md (notes on rotation cadence and partial screenshots)

Drive folder (view-only): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2B_SIG_BlueRidge_Artifacts

Notes/flags:
- network diagram: we replaced exact AZ names with generic labels (AZ-A/B/C) per internal policy.
- KMS screenshots: included two images that show the rotation timestamp and key alias but we redacted full key IDs. Kim, could you add one more screenshot that shows the audit entry (timestamp + actor) without the key material?

I’ll wait for Elena’s confirmation on the redaction level, then we can finalize.

Thanks,
Marcus
Senior Systems Engineer, Redwood Inference

[Attachment: network-topology-diagram.png (image/png)]

From: Elena Morales <elena.morales@blueridgehealth.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Mar 2027 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Drive bundle: BRH SIG artifacts (first-pass)

Thanks Marcus — this is helpful. A couple quick clarifications:

- The redaction level looks fine, but we need at least one screenshot that shows the KMS audit log entry with actor and timestamp (we don’t need the full key ID).
- For the network diagram: can you add a brief legend that maps the generic AZ-A/B/C labels to the region/availability semantics (e.g., whether AZ-A spans multiple physical racks)? We don’t need exact placement, just whether AZs are isolated by rack vs. by region.

If you can drop those two items in the same folder, BlueRidge will be able to proceed with internal reviewers. We appreciate the quick turnaround.

—Elena

Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Mar 2027 16:48:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Drive bundle: BRH SIG artifacts (first-pass) — added screenshots and legend

Elena / Marcus / Priyom — I uploaded two additional artifacts to the shared folder per Elena’s ask:

1) kms-rotation-screenshot-20270311.png — shows the audit entry with timestamp and actor (redacted key ID).
2) diagram-legend.txt — short legend describing AZ-A/B/C semantics and isolation assumptions.

Folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2B_SIG_BlueRidge_Artifacts

We also included a short README in the folder that documents what was redacted and why (README_redaction_summary.txt). If BlueRidge needs a notarized copy or different transfer method for legal review, loop in your procurement contact and we’ll coordinate.

Kimberly Park
Sr. Technical Program Manager, Security
Redwood Inference
